about: Historical producer WIP targets for census and repair ordering, plus disabled idle expiry. These November 1 throughput estimates are diagnostic, never admission ceilings. Canonical pr_wip.py admission uses the matched caller's shared quota ledger and fresh runner backlog; actual API calls reserve at the shared client. Unknown evidence preserves existing bounded seats and prevents autoscale growth. Producer names, draft counts and historical quota-deferred heads do not attest current capacity.

ageRule.about: Old-PR rule (Tim 2026-11-22: "Yes, close at 10 days"; JOV-INV-011 v5). An agent PR gets one last repair try at lastTryDays old and is closed at closeDays old, with its Linear issue moved back to Backlog. Runs in summer-pr-no-stall.yml via scripts/summer/pr-age-rule.mjs. Ages count from PR creation.

expire.about: Idle expiry stays off; the age rule above is the automatic close path. Until it is turned on, `python3 scripts/lanes/pr_wip.py expire` lists candidates and `--apply` is an explicit, authorized run.
